core: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-level Wnt signaling
qualifier: Frizzled/LRP5 receptor regulation and paraxial mesoderm formation
name: Wnt secretion, Frizzled/LRP5 receptor regulation and paraxial mesoderm formation
rationale: All members act at the Wnt ligand-receptor level (PORCN-dependent Wnt secretion, non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling, FZD ubiquitination and WNT5A-driven FZD/ROR2 internalization, LRP5 mutant signaling, Wnt-driven paraxial mesoderm and ciliary localization); the Frizzled/LRP5 receptor regulation and paraxial mesoderm members separate it from its secretion-plus-calcium subset (C1), and it lacks the DVL/destruction-complex/TCF members of C2/C3 and the Hedgehog members of C4.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/calcium signaling
qualifier: Porcupine-dependent secretion and WNT5A-ROR2 calcium branch only
name: Porcupine-dependent Wnt secretion and WNT5A-calcium non-canonical signaling
rationale: Members are exactly PORCN-dependent Wnt ligand biogenesis/secretion (including LGK974 inhibition) plus the WNT5A/ROR2 non-canonical Ca2+ branch, without the Frizzled ubiquitination, LRP5 and mesoderm members of its superset C1, the canonical DVL/destruction-complex members of C2/C3, or the planar-cell-polarity/convergent-extension members of C4.
